Name: Foundation & Configuration Framework
Objective: Config-driven skeleton: regulator-as-config YAML model, corpus database schema, storage layout, CI gates. Adding regulator #31 must never require code.

Name: Versioning & Governed Storage
Objective: The trust core: one current copy per document, append-only archive, crash-safe atomic override protocol, full provenance (source URL, hash, run attribution, raw original).

Name: Collection Engine
Objective: Three stateless connector engines (sitemap-diff / RSS / API), fetch & HTML/PDF→markdown normalization, PDF harvesting, dedup, pagination, crawl hardening.

Name: Source Verification & Regulator Onboarding
Objective: No source is trusted until the verification harness passes it. Onboard all 30 regulators with recorded test fixtures and provable completeness (expected-inventory reconciliation).

Name: Orchestration, Operations & Data Quality
Objective: Fleet fan-out with failure isolation, humane run statuses, live progress, daily delta pollers, manual interjection lane, backups, bot-block fallbacks.

Name: Deterministic Enrichment & Knowledge Graph
Objective: No-LLM enrichment: reference-number grammars per regulator, citation mining into a supersedes/references graph, expected-inventory completeness checks.

Name: Analyst & Operator Dashboard
Objective: Five-page UI: Coverage tree with coverage-%, Corpus browser, file Explorer, Changes/impact feed with diffs, Collection-runs monitor with live counters.

Name: MCP Tool Surface & Security
Objective: Twelve stateless reg_* MCP tools (content + index planes), API-key lifecycle, authentication required for execution, per-key tool allowlists enforced.

Name: Agentic Integration
Objective: Plug the corpus into the existing agent stack: markdown projection in the agent's consumption layout, scoped MCP connectivity, chatbot guide, agent skills, citation eval.

Name: Future Enhancements (Backlog)
Objective: Post-MVP: govinfo full-text connector, simple-mode overview UX, Playwright fetch, Postgres, more inventories, digests, production hardening, LLM enrichment.
